methods.label: Translate the percentage and take a square root
methods.explanation:
A percent means out of \(100\), so \(x\%\) of \(x\) is \(\frac{x}{100}\cdot x\). The given condition therefore becomes
\[
\frac{x^2}{100}=4,
\]
which gives \(x^2=400\). The two real square roots of \(400\) are \(20\) and \(-20\). Since \(x\) is positive, \(x=\boxed{20}\), choice \(\text{D}\).
